description: NODE_ENV in a test file when the environment sets none (B23e): jest-cli's bin runs `if (process.env.NODE_ENV == null) process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test'` before anything else, so a file sees `test` as it loads and inside a test, in either of two files that run in two workers, and `jest.replaceProperty(process.env, 'NODE_ENV', ...)` finds the property to replace and puts it back. The recorder drops any NODE_ENV it inherits. A black-box run.
